statement: Implement all six Scenario A transaction-coordination fast-path priorities and payment/transaction breakdown telemetry: (1) eliminate duplicated participant persistence, redundant ACTIVE progress writes, unconditional post-CAS participant-set readbacks on 1-row guarded updates, and duplicate PENDING write-operation writes; (2) overlap independent participant BEGIN, PREPARE, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK stages under the transaction owner contract while keeping DurableWorkflowCoordinator sequential; (3) shorten partition holding time and support opt-in row-key-disjoint concurrent staging sessions with same-partition vs multi-partition concurrency experiments; (4) reuse pre-validated compiled operations across staging replay and skip empty-session read rollback transactions; (5) add leftmost-prefix and range pruning in resolveCompositeKeyPartitions plus idx_orders_customer_latest and configurable lockingReadMode in lagrange-oltp-adapter; and (6) add schema-version-fenced SQLite determinism compilation/EXPLAIN/root-page caching and RaftRsDurableStore synchronous-mode caching and sync telemetry.

constraints.statement: The participant-set compare-and-set in sql_transactions remains an authority fence; skip the follow-up authoritative readback only when the guarded UPDATE reports affectedRows === 1, and fall back to readDistributedTransactionRow on 0 rows or uncertain/lost answers.
Every coordinator-managed transaction retains prepare-first TWO_PHASE_COMMIT with insert-once decision recording after all participant PREPARE digests/coordinates are durably retained.
DurableWorkflowCoordinator.executeParticipantStage remains sequential by default for non-transaction workflows; concurrent participant stage execution is owned by DistributedTransactionCoordinator.
